style: Authentic early 1990s Japanese fantasy daughter-raising character illustration; fine warm brown hand-drawn contour lines; flat opaque local colors; one sharply defined shadow tone per surface; restrained hard-edged highlights; a harmonious limited palette of ivory, sage mint green and dusty rose; bright, clean and fresh.
character: Chestnut brown shoulder-length bob with lightly curled ends and wispy bangs; amber-brown eyes; dark sage hair ribbon; modest ivory high-collar puff-sleeve blouse; rose neck bow; sage pinafore dress; narrow brown belt; ivory stockings; brown lace-up boots; holding a small green book.
notes: 幼年默认立绘直接沿用已确认测试图，不重画五官。原三色衣装保留配色叠层；新夏装、冬装、礼服按三年龄阶段单独绘制整套透明人物，保证衣物遮挡关系。背景、人物与服装、特效、UI 独立显示；表情头像用于谈心与事件。活动、关键事件、三区域战斗和十一结局配图见 production-v1。
